svg.aria-label: Sixteen verification checks laid out by pillar and level, each tagged external or structural with what it compares against
svg.title: The verification matrix
svg.text: Every check is external (compares against something the finder did not write) or structural (compares the statement with itself).
Only external checks separate the levels; structural checks reject malformed statements.

svg.text: external: a pinned key, an expectation the receiver obtained independently, or the receiver's own execution
structural: self-consistency; a finder that writes both sides can always satisfy it
